content.thinking: The Twitter preview isn't working because the card type and image dimensions don't match — I'm using `summary_large_image` which expects a 2:1 aspect ratio, but the image is square at 1254x1254. I should switch to the `summary` card type since that works better with square images. I'm also noticing the meta description is just a copy of the title, which won't help Twitter display meaningful preview text.

input.description: Check Astro config and og-image dimensions

content.text:
Twitter requires `summary_large_image` to have a wide image (ideally 1200x630 or at least 2:1 ratio). Your 1254x1254 square will fall back to a small thumbnail. Two fixes needed: switch the Twitter card to `summary` (square image, shows nicely) OR keep `summary_large_image` and use a wide image. Also Twitter needs an absolute URL (you have that) and `twitter:image` should be set (you have that).

The main reason previews don't show is often that the image isn't square-friendly for `summary_large_image`. Let me change to `summary` card type which works well with your square image, and add the missing `twitter:site`/`twitter:creator` is optional.

These diagnostics are pre-existing Astro/TS noise (React types misapplied to .astro), unrelated to my edit.

Changed Twitter card to `summary` since your og-image is square (1254×1254) — `summary_large_image` requires a wide image (1.91:1 ratio, e.g. 1200×630) and would otherwise show a small/cropped thumbnail or fail to render. Also added `twitter:url` for completeness.

After deploying, validate at https://cards-dev.twitter.com/validator (or post the link to clear Twitter's cache). If you want the large card instead, regenerate `og-image.png` at 1200×630.
